        ,["soundfile"] = ""
        ,["type"] = "consonant"
       }
  -- INDETERMINACY symbols
  -- TRANSCRIPTION
 ,["IPA"] = {
         ["name"] = "IPA"
        ,["wikipage"] = "IPA"
        ,["soundfile"] = ""
        ,["type"] = ""
       }
}

local symbols_to_return = {}; for k, v in pairs(symbols) do
  for x, y in pairs(k) do
    symbols_to_return[y] = v
  end
end

return {
  symbols = symbols_to_return
 ,correspondences = correspondences
}
